10:30-10:40: Break. Get up, drink some water, don't touch your phone.

10:40-11:30: APUSH chapters

Sure, here's the revised order:

9:30-10:30: AP Chem review (same as before)

10:30-10:40: Break

10:40-11:20: Mom sheet numbers
- Aim for finished figures, not polished formatting. Mark anything you still need to look up with a placeholder.

11:30-12:15: APUSH chapters
